title: Bag of Bricks- Deep Blue 13
descriptionHtml:
Deep Blue — colour 13

A rich midnight blue that adds weight without going fully black. Perfect for night skies, denim and deep water, and excellent as a background that pushes a bright subject forward.

Works well with: Dark Blue 19, Shiny Blue 05, Sapphire Blue 33

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Deep Blue bricks (colour 13) for Memobrick mosaics. A rich midnight blue for night skies, denim and dramatic depth behind a subject.
